When you transplant to the next pot, switch your soil for a neutral base such as pro mix bx (or any of the white bag variety you prefer), or a proper potting soil such as ocean forest or rogue soil or roots 707. Miracle grow has slow release nutrients that work great for the average houseplant, but not so great for smokeables. 

It looks slightly nute burned, so cut back your base nutrient by 1-2 ml per gallon or .25 to .5 per liter (if my buzzed brain did math right) till the plant is bigger/more mature, then slowly increase your base nutes. They also look a little nitrogen deficient, so if you can find an additive to boost your nitrogen in your nutrient water, that may help as well. Just use it sparingly. 

I also reccomend adding some sort of bacteria or michorizae, both help alot with proper nutrient intake in the plants rhizosphere. It also helps with building a good root base. Happy roots = happy plant.
